description:
In a comprehensive look at the life and career of American soccer legend Clint Dempsey, this new five-episode docuseries traces Dempsey’s dramatic and improbable journey from a trailer park in Nacogdoches, Texas to starring for the U.S. at the FIFA World Cup.

You Don't Know Where I'm From, Dawg premieres April 14 on Paramount+.
